_readme: INTEGRATION FIXTURE. A test asset, not a seed: `data/` stays the
only seed directory and `scripts/seed.ts` its only reader. The
integration seed reads this directory and nothing under `data/`.
This file carries `connectors` rows, each transcribed from the web
fixture module named in its `_comment`, so the web's fixture path
and a seeded `ar_live` tell one story. Keys beginning with an
underscore are commentary, not columns. Connectors carry no domain:
the table has no `domain_id`, so these rows belong to the deployment.
`fixtureId` is not a column. The database issues `connectors.id`;
the member keeps the `id` the web fixture gave the row, while
holds and the one an export subscription resolves a target by.
